jobs.prompt: A fictional ceramic atelier named FORM / EARTH. A beautiful editorial website concept with oversized clay-colored typography, a sculptural cobalt vase, irregular photographic cropping, warm ivory background. A confident, distinctive composition with no laptop frame. Main heading: Objects with a human pulse.

NIGHT GARDEN, a fictional botanical hotel. An immersive homepage concept: deep plum night sky, luminous tropical foliage, small acid-yellow type, cinematic pool reflection, daring asymmetric layout. Main heading: Stay a little wild. Sophisticated and quiet, not a generic resort template.

SLOW FAST CLUB, a fictional community running brand. A joyful art-directed campaign with cobalt blue, butter yellow, tactile paper collage, a runner's exaggerated shadow, and a big expressive typographic headline: Your pace. Our place. A strong single visual idea, immediately understandable.
Three brands. Three completely different worlds. Your website should feel like you, not like everyone else.
jobs.direction: Warm, conversational and confident. Pause between the first two sentences. No exaggerated announcer voice.
